title: Founding AI Engineer
job_description:
Founding AI Engineer

About Skiffra
Skiffra is building the intelligence layer for operational decision-making in physical industries.
We're developing AI-native orchestration systems that turn complex, high-stakes operations into intelligent, adaptive workflows. We're starting with mining and natural resources, where decisions move people, equipment and capital, and where the consequences of getting them wrong are real.
Our ambition extends well beyond mining. We're building a platform designed to change how physical industries make decisions.
As a Founding AI Engineer, you will be the architect of our core intelligence. This is a role for a high-leverage builder who can move fluidly between prompt engineering, backend systems, and model optimization. You will design the "brain" of Skiffra, moving agentic workflows from whiteboards to production-grade systems that handle real enterprise data at scale. This is a founding-level role for builders who value shipping over dogma and real-world impact over demos.
This is a full-time role in our Los Angeles office.

What You'll Do
• Architect & Build Agentic Systems: Design, prototype, and harden production-grade orchestration frameworks that leverage LLMs, persistent memory, and tool-integration to navigate complex, non-linear enterprise tasks

• Build the Data Flywheel: Implement sophisticated RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, ensuring high-fidelity context retrieval from fragmented data sources

• Evaluate & Iterate: Build internal benchmarking and evaluation suites to measure and improve model reliability, grounding, and latency

• Strategic Modeling: Architect high-performance intelligence stacks by making pragmatic trade-offs between Frontier Reasoning Models for long-horizon agentic planning, Fine-tuned Open-Weight Models for data sovereignty and low-latency inference, and Deterministic Heuristics for reliable, cost-efficient guardrails

• Cross-Collaboration: Partner with product and engineering to turn ambiguity into working software

What We're Looking For
• Systems Engineering: 7+ years of experience and a deep background in building production software. You understand that "AI" is only as good as the infrastructure surrounding it

• Modern AI Fluency: Deep practical experience with the transformer-based stack: embeddings, vector databases, tool-calling, and context window management

• Production LLM Experience: 2+ years shipping LLM-based products to real users in production

• Python Power-User: You are comfortable building entire systems, not just experimenting in notebooks

• Reliability Mindset: You have strong instincts for failure modes (hallucinations, API timeouts, "infinite loops" in agents) and how to build guardrails against them

• Security Mindset: You treat access to enterprise data as part of the design, not an afterthought

• Clear communicator with founder-level ownership mindset

Nice to Have
• Experience in building complex, multi-step workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex or PydanticAI

• Hands-on experience with Fine-tuning and PEFT (LoRA/QLoRA) to adapt open-weight models for domain-specific tasks

• Experience with human-in-the-loop workflows and enterprise identity (SSO, role-based access)

• A background in Enterprise Operations (Industrial, Logistics, Fintech, or CRM workflows).

• Strong opinions on where AI creates value and where it's just expensive noise

How We Work
We value speed, clarity, and technical rigor. We favor simple systems over clever ones, prototypes over over-planning, and ownership over handoffs. You’ll work directly with founders and ship things that matter quickly.

Location & Work Model
This is a hybrid role requiring regular in-person collaboration at the designated office location, as specified in the job posting (Los Angeles, San Francisco, Montreal, or Brisbane). We are not a fully remote company.

Work Authorization
Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where this role is based. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Benefits & Eligibility
This position is eligible for Skiffra’s standard benefits, including health insurance and retirement plans, and may also qualify for participation in the Company’s bonus and incentive programs.

Equal Opportunity
Skiffra is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

job_description:
Lead ML Engineer

Storytelling is, and will always be, the heart of what we do at Skydance.

If you’re energized by the opportunity to help build the next-generation global media and entertainment company powered by creativity and technology, we’d be thrilled to welcome you aboard. LET’S GO!

Job Title: Lead ML Engineer

Team: Technology - Enterprise Solutions

Location: Los Angeles (Burbank)

Overview

Paramount’s Platforms & Intelligent Automation team (Enterprise Solutions & Technology) is building a knowledge layer for the company. This layer helps AI agents and decision-makers access important information. It includes titles and content, rights and contracts, talent and participants, and other business data that connects them. As our Lead Machine Learning Engineer for Enterprise Knowledge Graph & Ontology, you will design Paramount’s enterprise ontology and knowledge graphs. You will build machine learning systems to ensure these graphs are precise. This includes tasks like entity resolution, LLM-based information extraction, and graph learning. You will also deploy models and graph services. This will help create knowledge-grounded AI agents. They will have a consistent and semantically linked view of the business. You will set the technical direction for this program. This includes data modeling, MLOps, and production operations. You will work autonomously, with minimal oversight. Close collaboration with data owners, enterprise architects, and agent developers across Enterprise Solutions & Technology and the business units will be key.

Key Responsibilities

• Enterprise ontology and semantic modeling (25%). Design and manage Paramount’s enterprise ontology and domain models. This includes content and title hierarchies. It also covers rights and obligations, talent and participants, organizations, deals, and financial and operational entities. Ensure that all of these align with industry standards. You make the modeling decisions; enterprise-wide changes are ratified with data owners and architecture review.
• Knowledge graph construction and entity resolution (25%). Build scalable pipelines that control both structured and unstructured systems. This includes structured data from rights management, ERP, contract and talent systems, and metadata catalogs. It also includes unstructured sources like contracts, scripts, and documents. The goal is to create knowledge graphs using platforms like Spanner Graph, Neo4j, or Amazon Neptune. Use machine learning for entity resolution and record linkage, along with LLM-based information extraction and data quality scoring. Manage the master-identity process to align entities across these systems.
• Advanced machine learning on graphs (20%). Develop, evaluate, and deploy graph-based learning techniques. These techniques include node and link prediction, graph neural networks, and graph embeddings. Work on predictive and semantic search as well. This includes GraphRAG retrieval, which supports knowledge-grounded agents. Additionally, set the evaluation methodology. Establish the quality standards for the program.
• MLOps and production knowledge services (15%). Use Vertex AI Pipelines and MLflow to productionize models and graph services. Implement versioning and use feature stores. Set up automated evaluation, monitoring, and drift detection. Share knowledge through well-governed APIs and MCP tools. Make sure agent applications can use these tools while meeting security, privacy, and audit requirements.
• Stakeholder partnership and program management (10%). Partner with Rights, Finance, Content Operations, and Talent business leads. Work with engineers in enterprise data governance and AI platforms. Define key questions and service levels. Create a plan. Translate requirements for offshore and vendor data engineers, and review their work.
• Standards, reuse and mentorship (5%). Establish modeling standards, reusable graph and ML components and documentation; mentor engineers and data scientists in knowledge engineering and graph machine learning.
• Ad hoc. Perform various ad hoc projects as needed, including executive proofs-of-concept and evaluation of emerging graph, retrieval and model capabilities.

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in machine learning, data, or software engineering, including 3+ years building knowledge graphs, semantic data models, or entity-resolution systems in production.
• Expertise in Python and SQL, and proficiency with ML frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow, plus scikit-learn).
• Hands-on experience with at least one graph database (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, TigerGraph) and one graph query language (Cypher/GQL, SPARQL, or Gremlin).
• Robust knowledge of ontology and semantic-web standards (RDF, OWL, SHACL, SKOS) and/or property-graph modeling, with experience turning business concepts into governed, versioned models.
• Proven experience with entity resolution at scale (e.g., probabilistic or embedding-based matching, Splink, Zingg, Senzing) and LLM-based information extraction from documents.
• Hands-on experience with graph machine learning is required. This includes working on graph embeddings and link prediction using PyTorch Geometric or DGL. Experience with classical predictive modeling is also needed. Involving thorough offline and online evaluation.
• Experience deploying ML on a major cloud (Google Cloud preferred; AWS or Azure acceptable) with MLOps practices such as CI/CD pipelines, model registry, and monitoring.
• Proficient communication skills: able to gather requirements from business experts, document models clearly, and present trade-offs to senior stakeholders. Experience working with distributed or offshore teams is a plus.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Science or a related field, or equivalent applicable experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Media and entertainment experience (e.g., rights and royalties, content metadata, distribution and avails) or experience with rights-management platforms.
• Experience with GraphRAG, including hybrid retrieval (vector search plus graph traversal) and connecting knowledge to agent frameworks (e.g., Google ADK, LangGraph) via MCP.
• Experience with master data management and data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Informatica, Google Dataplex), and with data-product or data-mesh delivery.
• Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning or Information Science; publications, patents or open-source contributions in knowledge graphs, NLP or graph ML.
• Experience with Wikidata / Wikibase, Palantir Foundry Ontology as enterprise context layers for AI agents.

About Skydance

Skydance is a next-generation global media and entertainment company, comprised of three business segments: Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, and TV Media. Skydance's portfolio unites legendary brands, including Paramount, Warner Bros., HBO and HBO Max, Paramount+, Pluto TV, CBS, CNN, CBS Sports, TNT Sports, Nickelodeon, Cartoon Network, MTV, Food Network, BET, HGTV, and Comedy Central.

title: Snowflake Cortex AI Engineer
job_description:
The Role

Cogniify is hiring a Snowflake Cortex AI Engineer with 3 to 6 years of experience to build production AI solutions on the Snowflake AI Data Cloud. You will build AI agents, natural language data search and text-to-SQL tools using Snowflake Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst and Cortex Search.

This is a hands-on role that mixes data engineering and AI. You will design semantic models, build RAG and agentic workflows, set up evaluation and observability, and take each solution from proof of concept (PoC) to a secure, governed production system that can scale.

You will work with business and technical teams, run workshops, and explain designs and trade-offs in plain language to both engineers and executives.

Core skills for this role: Snowflake, Snowflake Cortex, Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, Cortex AI Functions (AISQL), Semantic Views, Document AI, Snowpark, RAG, embeddings, text-to-SQL, prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, SQL and Python.

What You Will Do

• Design and build AI applications on Snowflake with Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search, Cortex AI Functions (AISQL), Document AI and Snowflake CoWork (formerly Snowflake Intelligence).
• Build and refine semantic models and Semantic Views, so people can ask questions about structured data in plain English and get accurate, governed answers.
• Develop agentic workflows and RAG solutions that combine structured and unstructured data, with reusable agent tools, skills and orchestration patterns.
• Prepare and model data in Snowflake with SQL, Python and Snowpark, and tune it for speed and cost.
• Set up evaluation frameworks and observability, so you can measure answer quality, catch errors and improve every release.
• Tune cost, performance, latency and concurrency for Cortex workloads, so solutions can grow from hundreds to thousands of users.
• Apply security, governance and responsible AI controls, including RBAC, masking, row access policies, guardrails and audit trails.
• Take solutions from PoC to production, with clear architecture, documentation and a clean handoff.
• Run workshops with business teams, turn requirements into technical designs, and present architectures and trade-offs to technical and executive audiences.
• Create reusable accelerators and patterns, support junior team members, and keep up with the fast-moving Snowflake Cortex roadmap.

What We Are Looking For

• 3 to 6 years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, data architecture or AI/ML delivery.
• Production experience with Snowflake Cortex, including at least two of these: Cortex Agents, Cortex Analyst with Semantic Models or Views, Cortex Search, Cortex AI Functions (such as AI_COMPLETE, AI_CLASSIFY, AI_EXTRACT, AI_AGG and AI_EMBED), or Snowflake CoWork (Snowflake Intelligence).
• Solid understanding of RAG, embeddings, text-to-SQL, prompt engineering, and evaluation and observability practices.
• Strong SQL and Python skills.
• Hands-on Snowflake experience in data modeling, performance tuning, Snowpark, security and governance.
• Experience delivering data or AI projects with business stakeholders, from requirements to production.
• Clear communication with both business and technical people.
• A BS in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• Authorization to work in the United States.
• A SnowPro Core or Advanced certification is a plus.
• Experience building or scaling production agentic AI systems, including evaluations, guardrails, cost and latency tuning and multi-user concurrency, is a plus.
• Hands-on work with Streamlit in Snowflake, Snowflake Native Apps or external agent frameworks is a plus.
• Experience with data in industries common in Los Angeles, such as media and entertainment, retail, healthcare, financial services or manufacturing, is a plus.
• End-to-end ownership of Snowflake and AI projects, from design to production, is a plus.

Perks and Benefits of Working With Us

Senior AI Engineer

Senior Data Engineer, Taxonomy, AI Data Modeling, MLOps, YouTube Business

In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

This role may also be located in our Playa Vista, CA campus.

Applicants in the County of Los Angeles: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA; San Bruno, CA, USA.Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
• 5 years of experience in data engineering, data modeling, or building and operating production ETL/ELT pipelines and distributed data warehouses.
• 3 years of experience writing production code in Python or a general-purpose programming language, and with SQL for data analysis.
• Experience building or scaling text classification, natural language processing (NLP), or machine learning data pipelines.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline or equivalent professional experience.
• Experience designing ontologies, versioned taxonomies, semantic layers, or metadata management platforms for large-scale unstructured text, transcript, image, or video datasets.

About The Job

Much of the organization's most valuable signal sits in high-volume unstructured data, including support call transcripts, partner feedback, images, and video metadata. Today, extracting insights often relies on fragmented spreadsheets and costly per-document Large Language Model (LLM) inference.

As a Senior Data Engineer in Technical Solutions, you will build the data foundation and metadata infrastructure that enables business teams and AI agents to understand YouTube's creator, partner, and support operations. You will replace ad-hoc workflows with durable, deterministic infrastructure: versioned taxonomies and ontologies, vector-embedding classification pipelines optimized for compute unit economics, and governed semantic data layers that allow stakeholders and AI tools to query business concepts accurately. Working across global engineering, analytics, and operations teams, you will own solutions end to end from scoping and data modeling through evaluation and production deployment.

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $156000 - $226000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Design, version, and govern business taxonomies, ontologies, and metadata frameworks that establish shared ground truth for analysts, operational tools, and AI agents.
